outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge); it contains no bar chart or averaged plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
The bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red, and anti-HMGB1 intensity) show group means with error bars (n=20) but do not overlay the individual data points underlying each bar.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the check is not applicable.
The bar charts for SDH and COX signal intensity display group means with error bars and sample sizes (n indicated in bars) but no individual data points are overlaid.

The FACS results are shown as histogram/line plots of cell counts vs TMRM intensity, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays; the schematic portions of the panel are not plots of quantified data.
